title: Hall Effect Sensors Aren't Just For Gaming - Here's How They Work - BGR
summary: The secret sauce behind Hall effect sensors are their reliance on electromagnetism, specifically a principle of magnetic fields that their namesake, Edwin Hall, discovered way back in 1879. Countless other devices benefit from the accurate and contactless design of Hall effect sensors.
